verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses almost entirely on Asana's developer API, integrations, MCP server, and AI Teammate features; there is no documentation shown here of native project/portfolio 'initiative' tracking with status, priority, and owning-team fields (only tangential mentions of reading 'status updates' via API, e.g. asana-docs-4/9). Without direct evidence of this core planning capability, the axis cannot be credited.
